adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows no sustained shift-and-return pattern across P1 (687–692) or P2 (692–697). The onset offsets for P1 and P2 are opposite in N (−0.42 vs +0.58) and similar in U (+0.41 vs +0.52), inconsistent with a single temporary platform. Interior points (e.g., index 688–691, 694–696) show no persistent offset; motion is smooth and noisy without clear plateau. Missing index 693 breaks continuity between P1 and P2, and numerical tool evidence rejects the candidate pulse/continuous model. No genuine temporary platform is supported.
